title: Feature
description: A perk. In this classless ruleset, perks are the single character-defining progression table, gated by skill thresholds, prerequisite perks, and attributes. The `type` distinguishes how a perk is acquired: normal perks are chosen on level-up, `creation` perks (the former 'traits') are chosen at character creation and usually carry a tradeoff, and `racial_trait` perks are granted automatically by ancestry. Racial traits live only here: a race lists them in its `traits` array as core:feature/<key> refs (there is no separate traits table).

key.description: Symbolic snake_case key (the old string id) for human readability when editing JSON.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

type.description: How the perk is acquired. perk = chosen from the perk table on level-up; creation = chosen at character creation (the former 'traits', usually with a tradeoff); racial_trait = granted automatically by ancestry, never chosen; listed by at least one race's `traits` (core:feature/<key>); universal = always available

abilities.description: Minimum attribute values, keyed by attribute id (e.g. { "agi": 6 })

skills.description: Minimum skill values. Each entry is met when any one skill in `any_of` reads at least `min`; a perk that needs one skill lists one (M5-70, first normal form: one shape for every entry).

any_of.description: The skills that meet the requirement: a skill ref (core:skill/<key>) each.

perks.description: Prerequisite perks that must already be owned: a held perk { perk, rank }, held at that rank or above, 1 when `rank` is left out (M3-14; one shape, M5-70).

ranks.description: Maximum number of times this perk can be taken (1 = single-rank)

modifiers.description: The one statement of what this feature does: the contract modifiers it emits (docs/core/modifier.md, M5-35). A perk or creation trait uses source feature:<key> and origin core:origin/trained; racial traits use origin core:origin/innate (docs/modules/race.md#5a-what-a-race-emits).

unlocks.description: What the perk unlocks beyond a number a modifier holds: a summon power or nature (core:monster_template/<key>), or a bound weapon's material (docs/modules/monsters.md#summoned-creatures), or a combat maneuver: a character may attempt a maneuver only while holding a perk that unlocks it, and every maneuver must be unlocked by some perk (docs/core/actions.md#maneuvers). Each ref must resolve.

summon_bonus.description: A summon bonus this perk grants: the caster's attribute modifier adds to that group of a summoned creature's attributes (docs/modules/magic.md#summon-groups). The ref must resolve.

bound_weapon_effects.description: On-hit effects this perk adds to the holder's bound weapons (docs/modules/magic.md#bound-weapons); each must declare the enchantment channel. Every held perk's effects add.

command.description: The orders this perk gives a summoner's summons (docs/core/commanding.md): the AP an ordered summon adds to its next turn, how many summons one order reaches, and for how many turns.

reach.description: One summon per order, or every active summon.

share.description: What this perk lends to allies within range: the holder's attribute modifier on a group of attributes, as a morale modifier for some turns (docs/core/share.md, M3-14). Started by the inspire action.

bonus.description: The group lent to, and the attribute read, with a share per rank: a row of summons/bonuses.json. The ref must resolve.

range.description: Units: an ally farther away gets nothing.

turns.description: How many turns the lent bonus lasts.

rank_share.description: The share of the modifier per rank for this perk, in place of the group's (a tier-2 perk lends all of it at rank 1).

natural_weapon.description: The natural weapon this feature gives: a row of natural_weapons/core.json, rolled with the unarmed skill and sized by the actor's size (docs/modules/monsters.md#natural-weapons). The ref must resolve.
